title: Driftwood & sea salt soy candle
subtitle: A clean, coastal-scented jar candle
excerpt: A soy wax jar candle scented with a driftwood and sea salt fragrance oil, a dry, mineral-fresh combination with woody undertones. Good for bathrooms and rooms that benefit from a clean, unsweet scent. Makes one 200 ml jar; burns for around 35 hours.
sourceNotes: Driftwood and sea salt fragrance oil: a blended fragrance with aquatic, mineral, and woody notes. Pour at fragrance load 6-7% of wax weight for a clean scent without overwhelming mineral character. Soy container wax: pour temperature 60-65°C. Wick sizing: CD-12 or equivalent for 7 cm jar. Aquatic and salt-based fragrances can occasionally cause minor wax discolouration, test a small pour before a large batch.

recipe.batchNotes: Scales cleanly. Aquatic fragrance oils vary by supplier in salt content and spray dispersibility, verify the flash point on the supplier's safety data sheet before use.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Allow at least 24 hours cure before burning. 48 hours gives the best initial cold and hot throw.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: Effectively indefinite in a cool, dark place. Aquatic fragrance notes fade faster than woody or resinous notes; the woodier elements remain present longest.

glossaryTerms.definition: The temperature at which melted soy wax is poured into the container, 60-65°C for most container soy waxes, giving a smooth surface and good fragrance retention.
The first burn of a candle, long enough to reach the jar edge with the melt pool. Sets the behaviour of all subsequent burns.

content.text: Driftwood and sea salt soy candle is a clean-scented jar candle with dry, mineral, and woody notes, the kind of scent that reads as fresh air rather than as a perfumed room. Made with a single-pour container soy wax and a blended fragrance oil. Good for bathrooms or rooms you want to smell clean rather than sweet. One 200 ml jar; burns for around 35 hours.
